description: This file contains implementation of Transformer, TransformerEncoder, TransformerDecoder, and related layers for neural network models in PyTorch, including classes for encoder and decoder layers, mask generation, and utility functions.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Implements the original Transformer architecture with encoder and decoder components, supporting masking and causal attention.

classes.name: TransformerEncoder
classes.description: A stack of TransformerEncoderLayer instances, with optional normalization and nested tensor support.

classes.name: TransformerDecoder
classes.description: A stack of TransformerDecoderLayer instances, with optional normalization.

classes.name: TransformerEncoderLayer
classes.description: A single encoder layer with self-attention and feedforward network, supporting different activation functions and normalization options.

classes.name: TransformerDecoderLayer
classes.description: A single decoder layer with self-attention, multi-head attention, and feedforward network, supporting different activation functions and normalization options.

methods.name: _generate_square_subsequent_mask
methods.description: Generates a square causal mask for sequence masking, filling masked positions with -inf.

methods.name: _get_seq_len
methods.description: Determines sequence length from input tensor, considering batch and nested tensor formats.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes input sequences through the Transformer, encoder, or decoder layers with masking and normalization.

methods.name: generate_square_subsequent_mask
methods.description: Static method to generate a causal mask for sequence modeling.

methods.name: _reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes parameters of the Transformer model using Xavier uniform distribution.

methods.name: _sa_block
methods.description: Self-attention block used within encoder and decoder layers.

methods.name: _mha_block
methods.description: Multi-head attention block used within decoder layers.

methods.name: _ff_block
methods.description: Feedforward network block within encoder and decoder layers.
